reviews.title: No sounds
reviews.text: Cannot get the thing to sound alerts no matter what I do.

reviews.title: I like it, but I always have to go to the app to look in the reminders that I have deleted never go
reviews.text: Overall, it’s a good app. It needs to have a app that you can put on your home screen where you can always just open your phone and see it instead of having to go to the app. The ones that you delete aren’t actually deleted. It just needs major refresh update.
